title: Find out what you're owed
recap: Pipo worked out what you can ask the airline for.
funFact: Agents can write to companies for you, too. Next, Pipo emails the airline for your refund!
postcard: a busy executive at the airport smiling at good news on their phone: {answer}
situation: Oh no, your Friday flight got cancelled. Want me to work out what you can ask for?
facts: ❌ The airline cancelled your Friday flight
🏨 You paid $85 for a hotel that night
💳 You booked another airline, so you want your money back
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant for a busy executive. Help with what they ask. When you give advice, your first line says the main thing to ask for.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Tell me what I can ask the airline for
pieces.text: The airline cancelled my Friday flight. Tell me what I can ask them for.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: I paid $85 for a hotel
pieces.text: I had to pay $85 for a hotel that night.

pieces.label: I want my money back, not a new flight
pieces.text: I already booked another airline, so I want my money back, not a new flight or a voucher.

pieces.label: Get me as much as possible!
pieces.text: Get me as much as possible!
pieces.tip: "As much as possible" doesn't say what you need. The facts tell Pipo what you're owed.

pieces.label: What to ask for, most important first
pieces.text: Tell me what to ask for, most important first, in a few lines.

pieces.label: Explain every airline rule
pieces.text: Explain every airline rule there is.
pieces.tip: Every rule is a lot to read. Asking for what matters to you gets you a plan.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo what you paid.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you paid $420, so it can't say how much to ask for.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo about the hotel you paid for.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about the $85 hotel, so it didn't tell you to ask for it back.

signals: (?<!\b(not?|skip|decline|declining|refuse|avoid|instead of|over|reject|turn down|never|without|don't need)\b[^\n]{0,25})\b(re-?book(ing|ed)?|new flight|next flight|another flight|next available|alternative flight|later flight|different flight|(?<!(meal|food) )vouchers?|(travel|airline|flight|future) credits?|miles)\b
flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo you want your money back, not a new flight.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you'd already booked another airline, so it offered a new flight or a voucher you don't want.

lesson: Give Pipo the facts: what happened, what you paid and what you want back.
